objectives: Name the four kinds of notarial fees and when each applies.
Determine the material interest for any common act.
Calculate a proportional fee from the tariff, in leva and in euro.
Prepare a correct bill and explain who owes the fees.
Add the entry fee, the local tax and VAT to give a client a full estimate.

cards.front: Name the four kinds of notarial fees.
cards.back: Ordinary, proportional, by time, and for drafting and checking ([[znnd:90|Art. 90]]–[[znnd:94|94 ЗННД]]).

cards.front: When is a fee charged on the higher of the price and the tax assessment?
cards.back: When they **differ**: always on the higher ([[znnd:96:3]]).

cards.front: What is the material interest for a mortgage?
cards.back: The **nominal value** of the secured claim ([[znnd:97:1:7|Art. 97(1) item 7 ЗННД]]).

cards.front: What is the maximum fee under item 8?
A contract with a material interest of 10,000 € is certified under item 10. What is the fee?
The notary checked a client's draft and charged half of the fee. The same notary certifies it three weeks later. What is charged?
cards.back: Only the **other half**: a certification by the same notary within one month costs the remaining half ([[znnd:94:3]]).

cards.front: Is an oral consultation charged when it relates to a charged act?

cards.back: When the act is **performed**; for a circumstantial verification, when the request is **filed** ([[znnd:88:1]]).

cards.front: Who is liable for the fee when several persons ask?
What can the notary do about unpaid fees?
cards.back: Ask for an **order for payment** regardless of the amount ([[znnd:89:3]]).

cards.front: What is the entry fee at the Registry Agency?
cards.back: **0.1%**, at least **10 лв. (5.11 €)**; deletions and notes: half ([[tdtav:2:1]], [[tdtav:3:1]]).

cards.front: What is the range of the local tax on a purchase?
The notary certifies signatures in a village outside the town of the office, in working hours. What is the additional fee?
cards.back: **50%** ([[tarifa:23|item 23]] letter "г" ТНТ); out of hours and outside the town: **double** (letter "д"). In working hours in the same town: 25% (letter "а").

quiz.question: What is the item 8 fee for a material interest of 200,000 €?
A flat is sold for 70,000 €; its tax assessment is 85,000 €. What is the material interest for the fee?
options: 85,000 €, the tax assessment
70,000 €, the agreed price
77,500 €, the average of the two
155,000 €, the two added together
quiz.explanation: [[znnd:96:3]]: when the tax assessment and the certified material interest differ, the fee is collected on the higher of the two. Here the tax assessment is higher than the price.

quiz.question: A notarial will leaves a flat with a market value of 28,000 €; the tax assessment is lower. What is the fee for the will?
quiz.explanation: [[tarifa:9|Item 9]]: 50% of [[tarifa:8|item 8]]. 28,000 € = 54,763.24 лв.; bracket 50,001–100,000 лв.: 480.50 + 0.5% × 4,763.24 = 504.32 лв.; half: 252.16 лв. = 128.93 €. 504.32 is the full [[tarifa:8|item 8]] fee; 126.08 is a quarter; 30 лв. is only the minimum.

quiz.question: The office drafts a sale deed at the parties' request. What may it charge for the drafting?
options: The item 8 fee for the draft, in addition to the deed fee
Nothing; the drafting is included in the fee for the deed itself
Only the VAT on the fee for the deed, without a separate fee
A fixed fee of 30 лв. (15.34 €) for the draft of any act
quiz.explanation: [[znnd:94:2]] and [[tarifa:20|item 20]] letter "а" of the tariff: for a draft of a notarial deed the fee provided for the certification is charged, that is [[tarifa:8|item 8]]. A check of a draft that the client brings costs half ([[znnd:94:3|Art. 94(3)]]); 30 лв. is the [[tarifa:1|item 1]] fee for drafts of [[tarifa:1|item 1]] acts ([[tarifa:17|item 17]]).

quiz.question: A client asks for a written legal opinion that takes 1 hour 10 minutes. How is it charged?
options: Two hours at the item 15 rate: 30 лв. (15.34 €)
One hour at the item 15 rate: 15 лв. (7.67 €)
Free; a consultation relates to a charged act
Item 8 on the value of the matter in the opinion
quiz.explanation: [[tarifa:15|Item 15 of the tariff]]: 15 лв. per hour for a written consultation; the note to [[tarifa:14|items 14]]–[[tarifa:16|16]]: a started hour is charged as a full hour, so 1 hour 10 minutes counts as two hours. [[znnd:93:2]] exempts only oral consultations given on the occasion of another charged act.

quiz.question: Two clients asked the notary for a contract; only one paid half. What can the notary do?
options: Claim the rest from either client; they are jointly liable
Claim only from the client who did not pay his half
Write off the rest; the bill was issued to the one who paid
Ask the Notary Chamber to cover the unpaid half of the fee
quiz.explanation: [[znnd:87]]: the fee is owed by the person whose request the notary examined, and several liable persons are jointly liable; the notary may claim the whole rest from any of them and ask for an order for payment ([[znnd:89:3|Art. 89(3)]]).

quiz.question: The office used a wrong material interest and undercharged. What is the procedure?
options: A new bill for the correct fee, within 7 days of finding the error
Nothing; the fee collected on the first bill is final
A court claim for the difference, without a new bill
A new bill only with the written consent of the client
quiz.explanation: [[znnd:89:4]]: when the material interest was wrongly determined, the fees actually due are collected on a bill signed by the notary and made within 7 days of discovering the error. If the client does not pay, the notary asks for an order for payment ([[znnd:89:3|Art. 89(3)]]).

quiz.question: Is VAT charged on the entry fee of the Registry Agency?
options: No; VAT applies to the notary's service only
Yes, 20%, as on every amount in the bill
Yes, 9%, the reduced rate for state fees
Only when the client is a company
quiz.explanation: The entry fee and the local tax are state and municipal receipts, not a service of the notary, so VAT is not charged on them. VAT is charged on the notarial fee when the notary is registered under the VAT Act (outside the library); the bill shows the fee, the VAT and the amounts collected for the state separately.

quiz.question: The notary certifies a contract at a client's house in a village outside the town of the office, on a Sunday. What is the additional fee?
options: The double amount of the fee
50% of the fee, as outside the town
50% of the fee, as out of hours
25% of the fee, as outside the office
quiz.explanation: [[tarifa:23|Item 23]] letter "д" of the tariff: an act outside the office, out of hours and outside the settlement of the office is charged with an additional fee in the double amount. Letters "в" and "г" give 50% when only one of the two conditions is met.

quiz.question: The notary certifies a power of attorney at a client's home in the same town, at 19:00. What additional fee applies under the tariff?
options: 50%, outside the office and out of hours
25%, outside the office in working hours
The double amount, as outside the town
No additional fee for a power of attorney
quiz.explanation: [[tarifa:23|Item 23]] letter "в" of the tariff: an act outside the office out of hours carries an additional fee of 50%. [[znnd:95:2]] speaks of one half in total; the lesson notes the difference between the act and the tariff.

quiz.question: What is the minimum entry fee at the Registry Agency?
options: No minimum; 0.1% only
quiz.explanation: [[tdtav:2:1]]: the tariff of the state fees collected by the Registry Agency sets the entry fee at 0.1% of the material interest, at least 10 лв. The office checks the current tariff; 30 лв. is a notarial minimum of [[tarifa:9|items 9]] and [[tarifa:10|10]].

quiz.question: How are amounts in leva in the tariff read since 2026?
options: Converted at 1.95583 and rounded to the cent
One lev counts as one euro from 2026
They are void until the tariff is amended
Converted at the daily rate of the central bank
quiz.explanation: [[zvevro:11|Art. 11]]–[[zvevro:13|13 ЗВЕРБ]]: amounts in leva in acts are read in euro at the fixed rate of 1.95583 лв. per euro, with rounding to the second decimal; the tariff stays in force with its leva amounts converted that way.
